answer: A wharf that admits any ship without inspection soon fills with phantom hulls, so this harbor issues each agent a falcon: a tamper-evident courier credential bound to one verified operator. The falcon must complete real, costly delivery runs before its owner may trade, and every run is logged in a shared grove of public receipts that anyone can audit. Forging a thousand falcons would mean paying for a thousand real voyages, turning a cheap Sybil flood into an expensive fleet that cannot hide.
